name: funnel-chart
title: Funnel chart
description: How many make it through each stage, with the conversion and the drop-off between stages in words.

FunnelChartStage.description: One stage's drawing, hidden from screen readers (the stage that holds it carries its name). Horizontal: the conversion line (from the second stage on), the label and the count, then the track with its bar. Vertical: the count, the bar rising in its 160px track, the label, then the conversion and drop-off. The tooltip points at `[data-slot="funnel-chart-marker"]`, at the bar's end. Spans only, so it can sit in a button. Other props, `ref` included, go to its root `span`.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes the count. Default: the number in `dateLocale`.

props.name: dimmed
props.description: Another stage is on show: this one's bar fades back.

props.name: enter
props.description: Fades the bar in from 95% of its length, once, when it mounts.

FunnelTable.description: The funnel as a table: stage, count, from previous, from first, drop-off. The Funnel chart renders one, visually hidden unless `showTable`. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `table`.

props.name: caption
props.description: The table's caption, the chart's title.

props.name: visible
props.description: Shown on the page; otherwise only screen readers get it.

props.name: dropOffWarning
props.description: Share of the previous stage lost that marks a big drop-off. Default 0.5.

FunnelChart.description: The funnel in its card. See the block comment above for the anatomy, states and keys. Other props, `ref` included, go to the card's root `div`.

props.name: range
props.description: The dates the funnel covers, under the title (or the KPI).

props.name: format
props.description: Writes the counts ("€48,000"). Default: the number in `dateLocale`.

props.name: showConversion
props.description: Which conversions to show: from the previous stage, from the first, or both. Default 'both'.

props.name: dropOffWarning
props.description: Share of the previous stage lost (0–1) that earns the warning Badge and "big drop-off". Default 0.5.

props.name: showTable
props.description: Shows the data table under the bars; it is always in the DOM for screen readers.

props.name: loading
props.description: Skeleton rows at the height of five stages.

props.name: empty
props.description: The empty state's title when `stages` is empty. Default "No data".

props.name: error
props.description: Shows the reason in place of the bars, read out politely; `true` says "Couldn't load".

props.name: highlight
props.description: Index of the stage shown as hovered (state sheets, docs).
